summary: An independent repairer tells a customer whether it uses secondhand parts or parts from another supplier.
realLife: Washington HB 1483 (2025). The enacted measure's intake notice requires independent shops to disclose whether they use previously used parts or parts supplied outside the original manufacturer.
inGame: needs: an independent shop is preparing its intake notice.
gates: An independent shop is preparing its intake notice.

turns.what: The shop discloses an all-original supply policy.
turns.pulledBy: The shop uses only new parts from the maker.

turns.what: The customer follows up on the shop's outside supplier.
turns.pulledBy: The shop uses an outside supplier.
turns.writesBack: The customer asks about the proposed part before agreeing.
